purpose: Text-free runtime creator surface art; no slogans or baked controls

prompts.paper: Create a production-ready text-free 2D medieval game UI parchment panel, matching the parchment in the reference image. This is a standalone rectangular sheet of pale warm ivory vellum, front view perfectly flat no perspective, on genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Portrait ratio 1:1.15 approximately. Sheet fills 98% of canvas, centered, only a few pixels alpha margin. Subtly irregular torn/worn silhouette, corners rubbed and slightly chipped, dark umber dirt and handling stains building up within outer 7 percent, small foxing flecks and fibrous grain near perimeter. Center remains pale ivory with exceptionally subtle paper fibers and faint soft mottles, quiet and easy to read with black UI text overlaid later. Fine rich hand-crafted texture exactly like reference, restrained brown edging, NOT burnt, no dramatic holes. No lettering, no text, no emblems, no painted controls, no tabletop, no decorative border, no vignette behind sheet. Light from upper left baked into paper edge only. Output high quality RGBA with real transparency outside.
prompts.brass: Create one production-ready text-free square 2D medieval game UI button matching the dirty brass left/right arrow button MATERIAL in the reference, but WITHOUT any arrow or glyph. Perfect straight-on view, square centered and occupying 95 percent of square canvas, genuinely transparent background outside. Weathered ochre golden brass plate, gently rounded uneven corners, raised antique brass rim with interrupted worn pale gold glints along top/left, dark recessed seam around slightly cupped/hammered face. Many tiny pits, hairline scratches, brownish tarnish concentrated in corners and shallow bevel, slight green-grey oxidation sparsely at edge, softly mottled ochre center quiet enough for an overlaid dark chevron. Rugged tangible hand-beaten medieval brass, subdued satin not chrome. Shape subtly uneven, chipped in a few spots, never perfectly geometric. NO arrow, no text, no symbol, no bolts, no decoration inside. Button only on real alpha.
prompts.journey: Create one production-ready text-free horizontal 2D medieval game UI primary action button, same richly weathered dark ochre/brass BEGIN JOURNEY button style as reference. Wide horizontal ratio 5:1, front view perfectly flat no perspective, button centered and fills 98 percent of canvas width. Transparent background outside silhouette. Irregular bevelled rectangular shape with clipped/chamfered corners, thick dark worn leather/cast-bronze substrate and slightly buckled double raised antique gold rim. Deep honey/amber bronze face with dense fine pits and micro scratches, brown tarnish and dark grime collected along rim/corners, center restrained to support large cream title later. Broken warm golden top/left edge highlights, dark bottom bevel. Elegant practical medieval game craftsmanship, rustic material detail, slight asymmetry. Blank center. Do NOT include text, letters, arrows, runes, icons or flourishes. No scene, no tabletop, no large dropshadow, no outer background. Real RGBA alpha.
prompts.frame: A production 2D UI SPRITE of a thin worn medieval brass RECTANGULAR FRAME, on a transparent background with a fully transparent hollow center. RGBA alpha image. One large L-shaped screw corner cap at each corner. Corners each 60px; brass rails about12px. Landscape3:2 proportions. Straight-on, flat. All negative space has actual transparent alpha. Match a warm medieval strategy-game menu, elegant but imperfect and grimy.
